tools.name: xEdit (SSEEdit)
tools.license_note: Freeware (custom license), source included; accept the risk/backup warning on first launch.
tools.verified_notes: GitHub releases/latest -> tag xedit-4.1.5f, single asset xEdit.4.1.5f.7z (31.3 MB). Listed with sevenzip.list_archive: no wrapping folder; the generic TES-family binary is xTESEdit64.exe (32-bit xTESEdit.exe also present). Confirmed via xeInit.pas (dev-4.1.6 branch) that '-sse' selects SSE mode and 'quickautoclean'/'qac' triggers QuickAutoClean, so 'xEdit64.exe' from the task brief does not exist in 4.1.x builds -- xTESEdit64.exe is correct. '-D:"{game_data}"' (expanded to the instance's ModOrganizer.ini gamePath + \Data, e.g. the Stock Game copy) was added 2026-09-02 to fix xEdit reading the real Steam install's vanilla Data folder via the registry instead of MO2's VFS-managed one -- confirmed against E:\Games\Lorerim\ModOrganizer.ini (a working Wabbajack Stock Game build), which registers xEdit as '-D:\"E:\\Games\\Lorerim\\Stock Game\\Data\"' plus its own extra flags.

tools.name: DynDOLOD

install.note: Run TexGen (SSE) before DynDOLOD (SSE): TexGen builds the billboard/object LOD atlases that DynDOLOD then needs. Both write generated output (LODGen temp files under the tool folder; the LOD meshes/textures/plugin under the game's Data, or MO2's overwrite/ when run through MO2) that you must review and add as your own mod afterwards -- c2wj does not do this automatically. Install this tool's companion_mods (dyndolod-resources, dyndolod-dll-ng) first.

tools.license_note: Freeware; author-distributed (Sheson), also mirrored on Nexus; no redistribution permitted.
